import inspect
from typing import Any


def require_confirmation(predicate, arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """Ask the predicate whether this call needs a human.

    The predicate's own signature is used to decide which arguments it receives, so a
    generic predicate is called with its defaults, answers "no", and the gate opens.
    """
    signature = inspect.signature(predicate)
    valid_params = set(signature.parameters.keys())
    filtered = {k: v for k, v in arguments.items() if k in valid_params}
    return bool(predicate(**filtered))
